body:
🛑 Requirement: Preserve stdout behavior without --verify

Downloading an asset named `-` into the current directory now creates a file instead of streaming its bytes to stdout, even without `--verify`. Existing pipelines receive no data, and an existing file can make a previously successful invocation fail. The description documents this break but supplies no maintainer approval, as required by docs/command-development.md:66-69. Preserve the legacy route for ordinary downloads and keep staging file-only, or obtain explicit approval for the compatibility change. Update the regression test to reflect the agreed behavior.

🛑 Requirement: Test the policy passed to Sigstore

All new download verification tests use a stub that ignores the policy argument (provenance_test.go:178-179). They therefore cannot detect removal or misconfiguration of the attested-digest binding or signer certificate identity constraint; the tampered-download cases test only the later byte hash. Add offline policy-level tests showing that mismatched attested digests and signer identities are rejected, and that an allowed reusable-workflow signer is accepted. Use isolated fixtures or policy inspection to exercise this command's assembled policy, consistent with docs/testing.md:49-50.

🛑 Requirement: Establish contribution eligibility

The description says there is no tracking issue, and the supplied context does not establish maintainer authorization. .github/CONTRIBUTING.md:5 requires external contributions to target an issue labelled help wanted with explicit acceptance criteria. Please obtain clarification from `@cli/code-reviewers` through an issue/discussion, or establish trusted maintainer authorization for this scope before continuing the upstream implementation. Draft status does not satisfy this prerequisite.
